scope: Six lemmas prove positive scaled noise bounds, the affine noise column, exact signed midpoint errors, a necessary common-report budget, fixed critical-coordinate separation and a counterexample to global inference from a rejected report. The complete contraction, derivative/interval, modular and inherited field/spectral/arithmetic bridges remain written or computational.
